v2-1768392217513-a1d6tzcep.description: A volatile volcanic realm dominated by obsidian peaks and rivers of molten rock.

v2-1768392217513-1gppsmmy3.name: The Cinder Peaks
v2-1768392217513-1gppsmmy3.description: A treacherous mountain range composed of jagged obsidian and the fossilized remnants of colossal beasts.

v2-1768392217513-vksmmddmf.name: The Great Skull Dwelling
v2-1768392217513-vksmmddmf.description: A colossal dragon skull, its hollowed eye sockets serving as cavernous entrances, its bone structure reinforced and shaped into a formidable lair.

v2-1768392240652-holh847ye.name: The Great Skull Dwelling
v2-1768392240652-holh847ye.description: A colossal dragon skull, its hollowed eye sockets serving as cavernous entrances, its bone structure reinforced and shaped into a formidable lair. This ancient and imposing structure houses untold secrets and vast collections.
forbiddenTransformations: The skull structure appearing as made of modern materials
Any signs of organic life other than the dwelling itself
A bright, sunny sky visible from within the dwelling
Any visible technology or complex machinery
Signs of recent construction or repairs
Vegetation growing on the interior bone surfaces

v2-1768392240652-eocha4gq3.name: The Dragon's Treasure Hoard
v2-1768392240652-eocha4gq3.description: A vast chamber carved deep within the dragon's skull, the air thick with the scent of aged gold and ancient dust. Mountains of glittering treasures—coins, jewels, and artifacts—are piled high against the cavernous bone walls.

promptLayers.background: The immense, curving walls are formed from the smoothed and polished interior bone of the dragon's skull. Occasional deep fissures and natural cavities within the bone offer pockets of intense shadow, contrasting with the primary bone-white material. No sky is visible, only the continuous, enclosed bone structure.
promptLayers.midground: Towering mounds of treasure dominate the midground. Gleaming gold coins form cascading slopes, interspersed with the faceted brilliance of countless gemstones. Ancient, ornate chests lie open, spilling their contents. Some larger, fossilized teeth jut out from the walls, encrusted with precious metals.
promptLayers.foreground: The floor is uneven, a chaotic spread of scattered coins, loose jewels, and smaller artifacts. Fine layers of dust and ash settle over everything, disturbed by unseen drafts. The edges of coin piles and scattered gems catch the dim light.
promptLayers.lighting: Soft, pulsating glows emanate from within the bone structure itself, hinting at the residual energy of the dragon or hidden lava veins. This internal luminescence casts a warm, ethereal light that glints off the metallic surfaces and gemstones, creating a play of deep shadows and shimmering highlights. The overall light is dim and indirect, suitable for an enclosed, subterranean space.
promptLayers.atmosphere: An atmosphere of immense, ancient wealth and the dormant power of a dragon pervades the space. The air feels heavy with the silence of ages, broken only by the faint whisper of settling dust. The sheer opulence is awe-inspiring, yet the lurking shadows and the colossal scale of the bone structure evoke a sense of potent, untamed energy.

forbiddenTransformations: The treasure appearing as cheap plastic replicas
Modern security measures such as laser grids or alarms
Signs of recent human activity like footprints or discarded tools
The bone walls appearing smooth and featureless, lacking the natural texture of bone
The lighting becoming bright and uniform, eliminating shadows
The presence of any living creatures other than the echoes of the dragon
The treasure being organized or cataloged in any modern fashion

v2-1768392268649-zvfsg066z.name: Whispering Woods
v2-1768392268649-zvfsg066z.description: An ancient, primeval forest where trees grow to colossal sizes and a mystical aura pervades the air.

v2-1768392268649-bwmu3ne44.name: The Elder Grove
v2-1768392268649-bwmu3ne44.description: The oldest part of the Whispering Woods, characterized by exceptionally large and ancient trees.

v2-1768392268649-j4khj1em1.name: The Great Hollow Oak
v2-1768392268649-j4khj1em1.description: A monumental, ancient oak tree with a massive gnarled trunk and thick, moss-covered bark. A mystical aura emanates from its hollow interior.

v2-1768392286244-dgny2oebd.name: The Great Hollow Oak
v2-1768392286244-dgny2oebd.description: A monumental, ancient oak tree, housing a mystical interior. This venerable arboreal dwelling offers a sanctuary within its massive, hollowed trunk.
forbiddenTransformations: Rendering the tree exterior as anything other than ancient and gnarled
Removing the mystical aura from the tree's presence
Depicting the tree in a modern or artificial setting
Showing the tree as small or insignificant in scale
Introducing metallic or synthetic materials on the tree's bark or roots

v2-1768392286244-jgn1nhndg.name: Root Chamber
v2-1768392286244-jgn1nhndg.description: A dimly lit, subterranean chamber carved within the colossal roots of the Great Hollow Oak. The air is thick with the scent of damp earth and ancient wood, illuminated by a soft, natural luminescence.

promptLayers.background: The gnarled, twisting surfaces of immense roots form the chamber walls, their textures mirroring the exterior bark but darker and more compressed. Faint, glowing moss patches cling to the root structures, providing ambient light.
promptLayers.midground: Thick, interwoven root systems create natural alcoves and passages. The floor is a compacted mix of damp earth and ancient leaf litter. Some larger roots may form natural seating areas or shelves.
promptLayers.foreground: Close-up details of damp soil, exposed root fibers, and scattered, decaying leaves. Small phosphorescent fungi might be visible on the root surfaces.
promptLayers.lighting: The primary light source is the soft, internal luminescence of moss, similar to the exterior but more concentrated and diffuse within the enclosed space. This glow is cool and muted, creating pockets of soft illumination and deep shadows.
promptLayers.atmosphere: The air feels heavy, still, and deeply ancient, carrying the scent of rich, damp earth and the subtle, sweet decay of ages. A profound sense of being cradled by the earth and the tree's immense presence pervades the chamber.

forbiddenTransformations: Introducing any bright, harsh, or artificial light sources
Showing any evidence of recent construction or modern tools
Removing the pervasive dampness and earthy aroma
Making the roots appear smooth or polished
Adding furniture or objects that are not organically formed by the roots
Opening up the chamber to reveal an exterior view
Depicting the moss as non-luminescent or overly vibrant

v2-1768392361968-5aeho69zi.name: Treetop Observatory
v2-1768392361968-5aeho69zi.description: An elevated, open-air platform nestled high within the branches of The Great Hollow Oak. It offers a breathtaking panoramic view of the Whispering Woods, with the damp, cool forest floor visible far below.

promptLayers.background: A panoramic vista of the dense, ancient Whispering Woods canopy stretching to the horizon. The dim, filtered light suggests a perpetual twilight, with occasional shafts of light piercing through. The distant trees are a deep, mossy green.
promptLayers.midground: The sturdy, gnarled branches of The Great Hollow Oak itself form the immediate surroundings, interwoven with the observatory platform. Visible moss glows faintly, mirroring the luminescence from the trunk below. The wooden surface of the platform is worn and natural.
promptLayers.foreground: The edge of the wooden observation platform, showing its natural, slightly uneven texture. Below, the damp forest floor is visible as a tapestry of greens and browns, with the massive roots of the oak disappearing into the mist. Fallen leaves and patches of moss are evident.
promptLayers.lighting: The light is a continuation of the forest's filtered illumination – dim, dappled, and cool. The moss on the surrounding branches provides a subtle, organic luminescence, casting soft, ethereal glows on the wooden surfaces. No direct sunlight reaches this height.
promptLayers.atmosphere: An atmosphere of profound tranquility and awe, as if suspended above the world. The immense scale and the feeling of being high in an ancient tree foster a sense of peaceful isolation and deep connection to nature.

forbiddenTransformations: adding any visible sky or direct sunlight
introducing any structures not organically part of the tree
showing any visible man-made steps or ladders leading to the platform
rendering the wooden platform as polished or modern
depicting birds or animals that are not native to a mystical forest
showing any signs of decay or rot on the platform itself
